title: Janani Express Ambulance 102 MP
eligibility: Pregnant women, post-partum mothers, and sick infants (0-1 year) in MP
benefits: Free transport from home to delivery center/hospital
Free drop-back transport from health facility to home post-delivery
documents_required: MP MCH Card / Janani Suraksha Identity Card
application_process: Step 1: Call 102 when labor pain begins or health emergency occurs
Step 2: Provide address and target delivery center details
important_sections_or_clauses: Janani Suraksha Yojana & Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram Guidelines
